description:
Edit a presentation deck's metadata or slide design.

Can update:
- Deck name (title)
- Move to a different folder
- Full slide design (components JSON)

For design updates, provide the complete pages array. Each page contains:
- theme: { background, fontFamily, accentColor }
- components: array of text, shape, icon, or table components with coordinates

IMPORTANT: To edit design, first use get_deck to retrieve the current design, modify the specific parts, then send the full updated design back.

design.description: Full slide design to save. Must include complete pages array.

pages.description: Array of page objects with theme and components (max 100 slides)

folderId.description: Move deck to this folder ID (UUID)

name: edit_deck
